adversarialFindingsThisPhase.finding: The first draft imported EMPTY_TOOLS_SNAPSHOT from MapToolset.tsx into MapTools.tsx, which would have dragged the whole layers/registry module graph into Command Center's simpler toolbar for one constant.
adversarialFindingsThisPhase.disposition: FIXED — the constant now lives in mapToolsController.ts, which is the snapshot's actual home, and both toolbars import from there.

adversarialFindingsThisPhase.finding: A `keepOpen` marker only protected the exact element that carried it, so marking a REGION did nothing for the controls inside it.
adversarialFindingsThisPhase.disposition: FIXED — the rule now scans the whole path for keepOpen before walking, so one attribute opts out a whole region. Pinned by a test.

adversarialFindingsThisPhase.finding: The context's toggle/dismiss logic sat inline in the provider, where this app's node-only vitest cannot reach it.
adversarialFindingsThisPhase.disposition: FIXED — extracted to nextSheetOnToggle / nextSheetOnDismiss in mobile-layout.ts. The navigation guard is now proven by test, including the case where it must NOT fire.

adversarialFindingsThisPhase.finding: Test values could pass for the wrong reason if the geometry maths were wrong in a compensating way.
adversarialFindingsThisPhase.disposition: MITIGATED — distance and area assertions carry PRE-REGISTERED BANDS with their derivation stated inline (0.01 deg of latitude on a 6371008.8 m sphere is 1112.0 m, asserted 1111-1113; a 0.01 x 0.01 deg box at latitude 30 is about 1.07e6 m², asserted 0.9e6-1.2e6). A result outside the band is a finding either way rather than a silent pass.

seamsExposedForOtherLanes.seam: MapToolset prop `onLocated?: (p: { longitude, latitude, accuracyMeters }) => void`
seamsExposedForOtherLanes.purpose: Fires on every GPS fix. This is the hook for resolving the parcel the user is standing on. The map already flies to the fix (LOCATE_ZOOM = 17, matched to the control's own fitBoundsOptions.maxZoom); the parcel resolve needs P-39's subject state.

seamsExposedForOtherLanes.seam: MapToolset prop `noteScope?: { id: string | null; label: string | null }`
seamsExposedForOtherLanes.purpose: Stamps each note with the parcel it was recorded against. Without it a note still works but records no parcel.

The clean way to collapse the mobile layers sheet on tool activation. Until it is wired the component falls back to hiding its own sheet plus a window dismiss event, which MobilePanelProvider already listens for — so the behaviour works today, just less precisely.

Opt any control out of (or into) mobile auto-collapse. Controls carrying aria-expanded or aria-pressed, and all form controls, are already exempt. The one control likely to want the opt-out is Save property, which currently collapses the sheet along with everything else.
Workbench.tsx still hand-writes zIndex 9 / 11 / 15 and App.tsx writes 40 / 15. Those are the last hand-written literals; adopting the table finishes the single-source-of-truth.
